$comment: The immutable downstream handoff: one projection of the final MAS conformance report that GMPL, HERA and the later authoring campaign cite and must beat or extend — report/registration/fixture identities and the mechanical decision, the exact conformance/concurrency/restore numbers, the public capability surface, and the non-claims and deployment limits stated beside the wins. Executed verbatim with @jarenjs/json's compileJsonQuery; no application mapper replaces what this document says.

nonClaims: no natural-language workflow authoring: Role Assignment, Topology Design and Semantic Completion remain open roadmap work
no desktop authoring or run-trace surface; the desktop live hub remains a single global latest-run slot
no GMPL production collaboration templates and no HERA experience learning
no paper benchmark parity, cost or LOC reproduction from the MASFactory basis
deploymentLimits: durable queue and checkpoints are same-machine SQLite through the suite jobs tables; not a cross-machine coordination substrate
external effects are at-least-once with idempotency-key guards and an explicit uncertain state; exactly-once is never claimed
shared budget token overshoot under concurrency is bounded only by the other in-flight calls' usage, exactly the suite's stated bound
interactions inside loop bodies or nested graphs refuse as a stated runtime limitation
